name: SD: Cloud batch jobs on a credit budget (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A cloud batch platform, counted every hour: jobs queued, jobs running, results ready, and the compute credits left. Every job that starts uses up 2 credits; credits are granted at a steady rate that changes without notice, and when they run out the queue stalls. Finished jobs pass through a post-processing stage nobody counts before their results land. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-cloud-credits/truth.model.json), so discovery can be checked exactly. Tests co-flows: a flow that uses up another stock as it moves, in a chain with a hidden stock.
